With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.</p> <p>The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.</p> <p>Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.</p> <p>Certified as a&nbsp;<em>Great Place to Work </em>around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the <em>Financial Times </em>in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by <em>Forbes </em>for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.</p></div><h2><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Our Commodities &amp; Energy Trading practice is growing and we are hiring Consultants and Senior Consultants (m/w/d) to join our team in Düsseldorf or Munich. The level offered will reflect your experience, expertise and demonstrated impact.</span></span></h2> <p>We work with leading commodity and energy trading organisations, utilities, and large energy consumers, supporting them to navigate increasingly complex markets, manage flexibility in their portfolio and deliver large-scale transformation programmes.   • Fullstack Product Engineering: Build customer-facing applications, backend services, APIs, internal tools, admin interfaces, automation, job runners, and configurable workflows
  • Backend & Domain Logic: Design maintainable services, APIs, business logic, asynchronous processes, validation rules, and reusable components
  • Frontend Engineering: Build intuitive and maintainable user interfaces using TypeScript and modern frontend frameworks
  • Integrations: Connect applications with ERP systems, internal platforms, external APIs, databases, queues, files, and third-party services
  • Cloud & Production Ownership: Deploy and operate reliable cloud solutions, preferably AWS, owning monitoring, alerts, failure handling, security, performance, cost, and operational reliability

  • Hands-on with Claude Code, Codex, and agent-based workflows; GitHub Copilot-style autocomplete alone is not enough
  • Familiar with worktrees, subagents, MCP, structured prompts, harness engineering, parallelization, and validating AI-generated code and analysis to production quality
  • Strong fullstack/backend experience, ideally with .NET and TypeScript
  • Able to build production-grade services, APIs, scripts, tools, automation, and clean interfaces; comfortable with version control, review, debugging, testing, and existing systems
  • Strong understanding of application architecture, API design, domain modeling, integration patterns, asynchronous processing, and maintainable software boundaries
  • Comfortable with SQL, relational databases, schema design, transactions, migrations, indexing, and application-level data access
  • Hands-on with AWS or similar cloud environments, including storage, databases, queues, containers, serverless/scheduled processing, SDKs, and APIs

This role is less suitable for someone who prefers narrow responsibilities, fixed processes, or working within a single technical area without contributing to broader product and engineering outcomes.


Your benefits

  • Work across AI-powered SaaS and cloud-native products, use modern AI tooling daily, and shape pragmatic infrastructure that helps teams ship faster and more safely
  • Collaboration in an empathetic, appreciative team with room to contribute ideas and take ownership
  • Individual development opportunities, structured onboarding, and interdisciplinary collaboration

As a Senior Talent Acquisition Partner, Technical at vCluster Labs, you aren't just filling open requisitions, you are the architect of our engineering capability across Europe. In this role, you will serve as the primary ambassador to the technical community, identifying and attracting the builders who will shape the future of vCluster. You will have the unique opportunity to partner directly with Engineering and Product leadership, as one of vCluster Labs' first TA hires on the ground in Europe.

As a Senior Talent Acquisition Partner, Technical, your role will include:

  • Full Cycle Technical Recruiting: Own the end to end hiring process for Engineering, Product, and Technical roles globally. You will guide candidates from the initial talent screen through the offer stage, ensuring a seamless flow.

  • Regional Technical Expertise: Serve as our first EMEA based technical recruiter and build the practices needed to hire engineering talent across the region. You will stay closely aligned with the US based People Ops and Engineering teams while adapting to local market norms.

  • Strategic Sourcing: Proactively source and engage passive talent from the open source, Kubernetes, and developer tool communities, including hard to find software engineers. You will build high quality pipelines so we do not rely solely on inbound applicants for critical technical roles.

  • Data Driven Execution: Champion our structured interview process. You will ensure scorecards are utilized effectively to reduce bias, maintaining strict data integrity within our ATS, Ashby, to inform hiring decisions.

  • Candidate Experience: Drive an exceptional experience by ensuring transparent communication. You will treat candidates with customer centric speed, ensuring decisions are made in days, not months.

  • Partnership: Collaborate with hiring managers to define technical requirements and ideal talent profiles. You will act as a true consultant on market trends and closing strategies for hard to fill engineering roles, not just an order taker.

This role could be a fit for you if you bring:

  • Experience: You have 5+ years of full cycle recruiting experience, specifically for technical roles such as Software Engineering, DevOps or Platform, and Product, within a high growth tech startup.

  • Technical Fluency: You speak the language. You understand the difference between a container and a cluster, and you are comfortable discussing technologies like Kubernetes, Go, and Terraform with candidates.

  • A Track Record on Hard Roles: You have closed genuinely hard to find engineering talent before and know how to build a pipeline when the obvious channels come up empty.

  • Location and Reach: You are based in Germany and ready to be one of vCluster Labs' first hires on the ground in Europe, working across European and US time zones as needed.

  • A Builder Mindset: You are comfortable operating in ambiguity and enjoy refining processes to make them more efficient, especially as you stand up new technical hiring practices for the region.

  • A Data Centric Approach: You value results over tasks. You use data and analytics to track pipeline health and inform decision making.

  • High EQ and Active Listening: You are an effective communicator who genuinely listens to understand the perspectives of both candidates and hiring managers.

Bonus points for:

  • ATS Proficiency: Experience with Ashby.

  • Domain Expertise: Experience recruiting for open source technology, developer tools, or Kubernetes focused companies.

  • Global Reach: A background in hiring for distributed, remote first engineering teams.

  • HR Generalist Background: Experience beyond recruiting, such as HR operations, employee relations, or onboarding, that gives you a broader view of the employee lifecycle.

About vCluster Labs

We are a venture-backed tech startup and the company pioneering Kubernetes virtualization for the AI era. We raised +$30M from top-tier VCs such as Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, Doordash) and are in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to complement our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe and we have a remote-first work culture.

We are the leading platform for operating GPU infrastructure, enabling AI Cloud providers to deliver a hyperscaler-like experience to their customers and AI factories that need to build that same experience for their internal teams. Our platform delivers the full operational stack operators need to run their GPU data centers — managed Kubernetes, fast isolated tenant provisioning, and automated node provisioning and lifecycle management — enabling them to accelerate time to value, reduce operational burden, and maximize the ROI of every GPU.

We're the company behind vCluster, an open-source technology for virtualizing Kubernetes (10k+ GitHub stars, 40M+ virtual clusters created since 2021). Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI — a Kubernetes-native framework purpose-built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems.

Benefits

We offer the following benefits:

  • Competitive Salary: We offer a competitive compensation package, including equity.

  • Platinum-Level Insurance: Health, dental, vision, and life Insurance, including plans for you and eligible dependents (benefits vary depending on country).

  • Flexible Working Schedule:  You have a doctor’s appointment or need to head to the supermarket to get groceries at 2pm? We won’t have an issue with that. To us, results matter more than clocking in and out at the same time every day.

  • Workplace Flexibility:  We’re very flexible about where you work. We know things can change in life and we’re happy to adjust the work environment for you along the way.

Culture & Values

At vCluster Labs, we value and stand for:

  1. Make it Happen: We have a relentless bias for action and the grit to push through obstacles. We do whatever it takes to figure it out, put in the work, and ruthlessly prioritize the actions that drive measurable impact for the business.

  2. Own the Outcome: We understand that our responsibility doesn't end when a task is checked off; it ends when the value is delivered. We connect our daily individual actions to the broader success of the company and our customers.

  3. Create Wow: We measure success by the experience we generate, both inside and outside the company. For our customers, this means impressive speed and intuitive experiences. For our team, this means going the extra mile to support one another and to continuously drive each other to new heights.

  4. Open Source, Open Mind: We are actively contributing to and maintaining open-source projects. Internally, we foster meritocracy — the strongest ideas win, no matter who or where they come from.

  5. Build Tomorrow’s Standards, Intentionally: We don't just ship software; we define the state-of-the-art of tomorrow. We are fearless in tearing down old approaches to build something better, but we are disciplined in how we do it because we know our users rely on our technology to run mission-critical infrastructure platforms.

Compensation: €90K – €110K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus

raw.description:
Your Impact

Procurement is over 50% of revenue for industrial companies and their biggest lever for profitability. The hard part is not the software, it is that every single customer's reality is different: a different ERP, a different data model, decades of undocumented process. Generic platforms stall exactly there, and that gap is where most enterprise AI value quietly dies.

Forward Deployed Engineering is how we close it: engineers who sit inside the customer's environment, build in their data, and turn what they learn into product. This function does not exist at Tacto yet. You will build the motion from the start, collaborating with Product, and discover what Forward Deployed Engineering means for Tacto, figuring out how much value we can generate for leading industrials.

Your Tasks

  • Build the function. Charter, operating model, quality bar, metrics. Bring this function to the next level.

  • Hire the right talent. The team is there to grow. Hire exceptional Forward Deployed Engineers and build your own high performing team.

  • Own how we engage customers. Design and establish the processes for how engineers scope, embed, build, and hand over. This is the core of the role, not an afterthought to the technical work.

  • Build, hands-on, in customer environments. Agents, pipelines, custom logic on top of our platform, in real production data. You lead by shipping.

  • Turn one-offs into product. Work directly with Product and Engineering to convert what you build at the edge into platform capability. An FDE org that productises nothing is just an expensive consultancy, and you will make sure we never become one.

  • Lead the first FDEs. Find the rare people who are excellent engineers and credible in front of a Head of IT. Set the standard by being it.

  • Own the hardest customer rooms. Lead escalations with Heads of Procurement and IT and be the senior presence customers trust.

  • Be AI-native. Use AI to change what the function is capable of, then measure it, then build it into how the team works.

Your Profile

  • 5+ years building software close to customers: forward deployed or deployment-style engineering, technical program leadership in a product company, or an engineering-heavy path through top-tier consulting at Manager level or above.

  • You write code and you want to keep writing it. Python and SQL at working level, comfortable with data pipelines and integration architecture.

  • 1+ years leading engineers, or you have built something from zero and had people follow you into it.

  • Zero-to-one operator. You are comfortable when the process does not exist yet, and you write it down instead of holding it in your head.

  • Product instinct. You can tell a one-off from a pattern and you will argue the case either way.

  • Senior presence with customers, including C-level escalations, and the backbone to be clear about what we will and will not commit to.

  • Native or C1 German, fluent English.

Why This Role is Awesome

You are not inheriting a team, you are defining a function that most companies in enterprise AI are only starting to understand they need. Do this well for 12 to 18 months and you own one of Tacto's core technical organisations, with a direct line into the product roadmap and a hand in how leading global industrials adopts AI.

What This Role Is - and Isn't

  • This is not a people-management role with technical decoration. If you want to stop building, this is the wrong job.

  • This is not consulting. Nobody here bills days. You are measured on what customers can do afterwards and on what made it into the platform.

  • The first months will be ambiguous by design: you, a handful of accounts, and a blank page. If that reads as risk rather than opportunity, this is not a good fit.

Why Tacto

  • Backed to win big. We are Sequoia and Index-funded with €50M+ behind us. Our founders sit at the same table as the people defining the global AI agenda. We're building Tacto to be the lighthouse for European industrial AI.

  • A truly AI-native organization, with every resource you could dream of. All the leading AI tools and custom agents at your fingertips, plus dedicated people who keep us at the frontier.

  • High bar, high speed, genuinely fun. You'll be surrounded by extremely smart and ambitious people who set the bar high and push you to get better every week. Intense, fast, and the opposite of boring.

  • A front-row seat in the European startup ecosystem. Weekly exposure to leading founders and operators through internal and external events (Lunch & Learns, hackathons, community gatherings). Check out all upcoming and past events here: https://luma.com/tacto

  • You'll build something that lasts and that matters. You'll help build the company that keeps European industry competitive for the long term.

Interview Process

  1. Intro call with our Talent team

  2. Deep dive with Head of Customer Experience

  3. Onsite case study and discussion on future of FDEs

Our Background

Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material.

Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans.

Why It Matters

Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives.

But the world is changing. The US dominates the digital world of bits. China is scaling the world of atoms, manufacturing at unprecedented speed and scale. Geopolitics are more uncertain than ever. Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI.

Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech.

What We Offer

The people at Tacto are passionate about building the organization, growing themselves, and our product while having fun and being real. We have high expectations, great talent density, and a culture where your ambition, performance, and agency are what count - not where you come from or how big your ego is. You'll grow at the forefront of AI, have real ownership and impact, and be surrounded by the best people in their field who challenge you and make you better every day. That is demanding and rewarding, but that's where we thrive. Besides that you have:

  • Money: Competitive salary & equity in the company with real upside, so you are invested in our success

  • Workplace: A vibrant in-office culture (> 4 days/week) in a beautiful office in central Munich

  • Development: A development budget and regular exposure to exceptional people, e.g., Lunch & Learns, peer mentoring, external speakers

  • Time off: 26 + 4 vacation days per year (4 fixed “company rest days”) as well as regular off-sites and team events

  • Health: Wellpass membership, of course, a fruit basket (!), and access to Jobrad, for your health

  • Family & Social Security: Voluntary pension contribution, voluntary KITA subsidy for your children

Tacto is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or gender identity. description: About lemon.markets 🍋 We enable anyone to be an investor. Our mission is to grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses. By empowering FinTechs, banks, and wealth managers to offer investment products, we help create financial well-being for their customers. lemon.markets is a Brokerage-as-a-Service platform: simple digital access to capital markets through a single API. Our API-first infrastructure abstracts brokerage complexity with a well-documented API, a self-service customer operations portal, and a clear regulatory framework, so partners can launch customer-centric, compliant products in weeks, not months. As part of the dwpbank Group, we share a clear goal: we enable anyone to be an investor by making investing in capital markets more accessible. By combining dwpbank’s long-standing expertise and stability with lemon.markets’ technology-first mindset and speed, we are building a modern, modular securities services ecosystem. Together, we offer faster time-to-market, modular services, and a modern customer experience that helps financial service providers stay competitive and respond more flexibly in a changing market. Your Mission As our ICT Outsourcing Manager , you strengthen how lemon.markets manages and governs external technology services, outsourcing arrangements, and third-party risk in a regulated environment. Sitting at the intersection of Technology, Compliance, Operations, and partner governance, this role helps ensure that our provider landscape is transparent, well-documented, risk-based, and operationally under control. Over the next 6–12 months, your main focus will be to professionalise and stabilise our third-party management setup across external providers, tied agents, and intra-group outsourcing relationships. You will help turn recurring governance work into reliable operating routines, from assessments and reporting to escalations and evidence gathering. This is a hands-on role with real impact, especially for someone who enjoys creating structure, driving follow-up, and continuously improving operational processes. In this role you will: Act as the first line competence centre for ICT outsourcing and third-party governance topics, working across Technology, Compliance, Operations, business owners, and external partners to ensure risks and responsibilities are transparent and well managed. Own the operational execution of our ICT third-party and outsourcing governance framework across external providers, tied agents, and intra-group outsourcing arrangements, so that key relationships are assessed, documented, and monitored in line with regulatory expectations. Drive risk assessments, due diligence processes, and recurring reviews for new and existing third parties, coordinating relevant stakeholders and turning findings into clear actions, decisions, and follow-ups. Maintain and improve the outsourcing register, governance documentation, and supporting evidence base, creating the level of clarity and traceability needed for internal stakeholders, auditors, regulators, and partners. Prepare, structure, and run governance and review routines, including reporting, meeting preparation, escalation tracking, and action follow-up, to make third-party oversight more consistent, measurable, and decision-useful. Identify and advance process improvements, standardisation opportunities, and selective AI-supported automation in recurring third-party management workflows, helping the function become more scalable and effective over time. You’ll be successful in this role if you: Bring hands-on experience in ICT outsourcing, third-party management, vendor risk, IT governance, compliance-related operations, or a similar function in a regulated environment. Have a solid understanding of how external providers and outsourcing relationships are governed, documented, and monitored from a risk and compliance perspective. Are comfortable working with risk assessments, service levels, control evidence, recurring reporting, and cross-functional governance routines. Have enough technical affinity to understand IT services, security-related topics, incidents, and operational dependencies without needing to be a security engineer. Work in a highly structured and reliable way, with strong follow-up discipline, good judgment, and the ability to keep multiple stakeholders aligned. Communicate confidently in German and English, and enjoy making complex governance topics clear, practical, and actionable. You decide on the rhythm that helps you do your best work, with only shared core hours from 12:00 to 16:00 to support collaboration. 🏢 Hybrid work setup: You can work from anywhere in Germany within a hybrid model. At the same time, in-person collaboration is a key part of our culture. That being said, individual contributor lemoneers work 4 days or more / leadership lemoneers work 7 days or more per month on-site in our Berlin office, spending quality time together with the team at events, onsites/offsites or over team dinners. 📈 Grow with us: We take your personal development seriously! But also in the bigger things, like celebrating the onboarding of new partners or our annual offsites, where the whole company comes together to connect, reflect, and celebrate. 💛 Perks & benefits: We choose benefits that add actual value. We sponsor a Deutschlandticket for employees on unlimited contracts, plus 50% off on Beatvest - our partner for financial education and investing. 🏝 Workation: Get out of here! At lemon.markets you can work remotely from anywhere in the EU for up to 10 consecutive days at a time, and up to 60 days per year in total. <p>Hudson River Trading (HRT) is seeking a Technical Recruiter to join our global Recruiting team. In this role, you will focus on hiring engineers across our Trading Technology (live trading environment) and Research &amp; Development (enabling research) engineering teams. You will partner directly with hiring managers who have incredibly high standards, helping them navigate a competitive talent landscape. You will engage with deeply technical candidates, and manage the end-to-end hiring process for a variety of technical roles within HRT’s engineering ecosystem.&nbsp;</p> <p>HRT is one of the top quantitative trading firms in the world. We combine world-class engineering and scientific rigor with a low-ego, collaborative culture. Our people and our compute capabilities are our two most important differentiators, and that is where we are investing the most. We want recruiters who bring a unique perspective and curiosity, who can challenge the status quo of how to find the brilliant yet humble technical talent that make HRT so special.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Partner directly with engineering leadership on recruitment strategy, and be a proactive and consultative strategic partner to hiring managers</li> <li>Manage the end-to-end hiring pipelines of engineering roles from first outreach through offer acceptance, including navigating complex offer negotiations</li> <li>Provide a high-touch, white-glove candidate experience across both opportunistic roles and high-volume pipelines</li> <li>Apply an engineering mindset to your recruitment approach, continuously leveraging recruiting data &amp; title: Software Engineer - GPU reliability
description:
<p>Hudson River Trading (HRT) is seeking a Software Engineer focused on GPU reliability to join our Systems Development team. The Systems Development team builds and maintains the platform that is shared by all Systems teams to provision, monitor, and manage HRT’s server and network infrastructure. In this role, your main focus will be to develop tools in Python to analyze the performance of GPU hardware and build creative solutions to improve observability, reliability, and efficiency of the fleet. You’ll work closely with other engineering teams to deeply understand research and trading workflows and ensure that GPU infrastructure is utilized optimally. Strong Python skills and development experience are required, along with Unix experience and a background of managing GPU hardware at scale.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <p>This role offers a unique opportunity to make a significant impact on a critical part of our existing and growing infrastructure. Your responsibilities may vary day to day, but will include:</p> <ul> <li>Building and maintaining tools and software features to automate systems engineering workflows related to GPU management, monitoring, metrics collection, maintenance, and network configuration</li> <li>Troubleshooting software and hardware bugs on a fleet of GPU devices, including application, network, operating system, and/or kernel issues</li> <li>Working across HRT’s engineering teams to tune workloads and processes to use GPUs more efficiently&nbsp;</li> <li>Analyzing GPU job statistics to identify trends and areas for improvement</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <p>Required:</p> <ul> <li>BS and/or MS in computer science or a related field</li> <li>2+ years of relevant experience, including programming in Python and managing GPUs</li> <li>Experience using automation to solve problems and improve process efficiency</li> <li>Experience working with, troubleshooting, tuning, and deploying various types of GPU hardware</li> <li>Strong grasp of computer science fundamentals and software design patterns</li> <li>Solid understanding of Linux/UNIX operating systems&nbsp;</li> <li>Familiarity with open-source software</li> <li>Ability to debug and analyze problems quickly</li> <li>Skilled at balancing multiple tasks while maintaining meticulous attention to detail</li> <li>Ability to operate effectively as a team player and also work independently&nbsp;</li> <li>Ability to learn at a fast pace and apply new skills effectively</li> </ul> <p>Preferred:</p> <ul> <li>Understanding of Debian operating system</li> <li>Familiarity with systems configuration management and monitoring technologies&nbsp;</li> <li>Familiarity with continuous integration and continuous deployment tools and processes</li> <li>Understanding of networking protocols</li> </ul> <p>The estimated base salary range for this position is 200,000 to 300,000 USD per year (or local equivalent). The base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.&nbsp;</p> <p>This role will also be eligible for discretionary performance-based bonuses and a competitive benefits package which includes medical, dental, vision, basic life insurance, and enrollment in our company’s retirement savings plans. title: Research Engineer
description:
<p>Hudson River Trading (HRT) is a quantitative trading firm at the forefront of technological innovation. We build and deploy cutting-edge systems within one of the world’s most advanced computing environments to power our global trading operations. Our non-siloed, collaborative coding environment empowers talented engineers to make significant contributions and see their impact daily. At HRT, you'll be challenged to solve the most complex problems in trading alongside many of the brightest minds in the field.</p> <p>We are seeking highly motivated and skilled <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Research Engineers</span> who will work very closely with our Algo Developer (Quant Research) trading teams. These roles require exceptional programming fundamentals, a strong user focus, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment with constantly evolving requirements. Multitasking and context switching are inherent aspects of this role, through which you will gain insight into the ideation and execution of some of the world's most sophisticated trading strategies.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>Research Engineers at HRT work on a wide variety of projects. Examples include:</p> <ul> <li>Designing highly customized quantitative systems that enable Algo Developers to easily express and backtest new predictive signals.</li> <li>Building world-class research tooling to speed up Algo Developers’ research iteration.</li> <li>Aiding the development and deployment of very large deep learning models for HRT’s live trading.</li> <li>Improving HRT’s monetization systems which turn our predictions into profitable trades.</li> <li>Evaluating sim vs. live differences to improve the fidelity of our simulations.</li> <li>Building systems to monitor and manage live trading.</li> <li>Specializing in specific time horizons, from high frequency trading to mid-to-low frequency hedge fund-style strategies.</li> <li>Working across a very wide variety of asset classes (from equities to fixed income to options) and regions (from North America to Asia Pacific) – you’ll interact with markets across the world!</li> </ul> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design, develop, and maintain robust, performant, and scalable software systems.</li> <li>Optimize existing codebases for performance, reliability, and efficiency.</li> <li>Debug complex issues across distributed systems in a time-sensitive environment.</li> <li>Optimize both the mechanics and ergonomics of Algo Developer research workflows; this requires developing a deep intuition for research methodologies.</li> <li>Balance the short term goals of individual trading teams with the longer term goals of HRT’s generalized trading platforms across trading teams. Because we don’t work in a pod environment, REs on different trading teams are expected to share technology and ideas.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Completed a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. title: Fullstack Developer
description:
<p>Fullstack Developers at HRT work either on our platform team (i.e. you work on infrastructure &amp; tooling that supports all of our research &amp; trading capabilities) or our acceleration team (i.e. you are aligned with a specific algo research &amp; trading team). All of our Fullstack Developers have internal customers and deeply understand end-user needs. They build backend processes to ingest and transform vast quantities of data, and UIs to visualize and action that data quickly.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Work on our in-house distributed-compute framework designed for execution on a large scale within HRT’s compute cluster. This framework serves various teams, with our algo teams being the primary users, particularly for training complex models.</li> <li>Work closely with our Algo Developers and traders, building backend processes and UIs for them to oversee trading processes, execute manual trades, assess risk, and research improvements to our strategies.</li> <li>Work closely with a variety of senior technical and non-technical users and own projects end-to-end, from inception to gathering and refining requirements, forming and executing a structured plan, and managing ongoing support and iterations to the initial plan.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Architect web-based tooling to provide insights and enable real-time actions using financial data, operational data, trading activity, and more using React and Python.</li> </ul> <p>The interview process will evaluate your backend programming skills (primarily Python), and your experience working in JavaScript/TypeScript on a modern web framework (React skills are required!). raw.description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We’re hiring an Automations Engineer to build the systems that run our influencer and creator marketing program at scale. As the program grows, nearly every step—discovery, onboarding, contracts, content tracking, reporting, and payments—can be automated. You’ll own that automation layer end-to-end: designing, building, and maintaining the workflows and integrations that let a lean team manage thousands of creators without manual busywork.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on builder who is equally comfortable in no-code and low-code platforms (Zapier, Make, n8n) and writing custom code (Python or JavaScript) against APIs. You think in systems, care about reliability and clean data, and get satisfaction from replacing a manual process with a workflow that just runs. This role is highly cross-functional and will partner closely with the influencer/creator team, marketing ops, finance, legal, and data/BI.

What you will do

  • Creator discovery: build automations that query social platforms and databases for profiles matching brand keywords and follower thresholds

  • CRM data sync: automatically push new influencer profiles and contact details into the team’s database

  • Onboarding: send automated welcome packets, brand guidelines, and brief templates when a creator joins

  • Contract generation: auto-fill creator names, dates, and payout rates into legal templates from form data, and route for e-signature

  • Content reminders: trigger automated Slack messages or emails to creators before posting deadlines

  • Content tracking: use APIs to log when an influencer posts and capture live links automatically

  • Data aggregation: pull views, likes, comments, and clicks from social APIs into a central dashboard

  • Report generation: produce weekly and monthly performance spreadsheets without manual data entry

  • ROI calculation: compute cost-per-engagement and conversion rates automatically for each campaign

  • Invoice processing: route creator invoices to finance systems once content is verified as live

  • Payment status alerts: send automated notifications to finance and creators when payments process

  • Build and maintain the integrations and webhook triggers that connect social platforms, CRM, finance, Slack, and e-signature tools

  • Own reliability: error handling, monitoring, secrets management, and audit trails so automations run cleanly and securely

  • Validate and troubleshoot data (SQL) and document workflows so they stay maintainable as the program scales

Requirements

  • Hands-on experience building automations with no-code/low-code platforms (Zapier, Make, n8n, or similar)

  • Proficiency in at least one programming language (Python or JavaScript) for custom logic and API work

  • Experience integrating APIs and building webhook-driven workflows across marketing, CRM, and finance systems

  • SQL proficiency for data validation and troubleshooting

  • Systems thinking with strong attention to reliability, error handling, and clean data

  • Comfort with secrets management, authentication, and basic security and audit practices for automations

  • Clear communicator who can partner with non-technical marketing, finance, and legal stakeholders

  • You thrive in scrappy, high-ownership environments and are confident building systems from the ground up

Bonus

  • Experience with influencer/creator marketing platforms (CreatorIQ, GRIN, Upfluence, Aspire, or similar)

  • Experience with social platform APIs (TikTok, Instagram/Meta, YouTube)

  • Experience with e-signature (DocuSign) and payment/finance integrations (PayPal, Stripe, Bill.com, or similar)

  • Familiarity with data warehouses and BI tools

  • Experience using AI/LLMs to build or accelerate automations

Location

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Madrid, Warsaw and many more.


#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

We're a small, talent-dense team building a generation-defining company from Stockholm. We value extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We seek out people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

What we're looking for

  • Strong design taste - you can tell good from generic, and you can articulate why

  • Real fluency with AI generation tools (image, video, whatever's next) as a craft, not a party trick - you already have opinions about which models and workflows produce better output and why

  • Experience creating scalable brand systems, templates, tools, and guidelines that enable teams to execute independently - except here the "team" increasingly includes the AI pipeline itself

  • A portfolio of shipped brand assets - campaign visuals, social graphics, presentation decks, event materials, marketing collateral - plus evidence of AI-native production, not just AI-assisted

  • Comfortable with ambiguity - this function doesn't have a template at Lovable or anywhere else yet

  • Technical range - prompt engineering counts, scripting, automation and building custom tools is even better. We're not asking you to be an engineer, but the more range you have the faster the seam between you and the Brand Engineer disappears.

What you'll do

In one sentence: Shape how the world sees and experiences Lovable, using AI as the primary means of production.

  • Evolve Lovable's visual identity across all brand touchpoints

  • Build and maintain the visual system as something machines can execute against: style references, fine-tunes/LoRAs, prompt libraries, not just a static guidelines deck

  • Direct and review AI-generated output at volume across campaigns, social, events, and partnerships - you're the judgment layer, not the hands

  • Establish brand guidelines and systems that ensure consistency as we scale rapidly, in an AI-native production model

  • Work closely with a Brand Engineer who builds the tooling that lets you do this at scale - you define what the tools need to produce, they build the systems to scale and maintain them

  • Be scrappy and hands-on with whatever the brand needs - from a LinkedIn carousel to event signage, hand-made when hand-making is the point

  • Help set the bar for creative quality and taste at Lovable

How we hire

  1. Fill in a short form then jump on an initial exploratory call.

  2. We'll send you a quick take-home asking to present your best work over a loom video presentation.

  3. Join us for a round of interviews to discuss your experience in more depth

  4. Join us for trial work lasting 1-2 days remote or on-site. We'll see how you tick and you get to meet the team and explore whether joining Lovable feels right for you.

title: Senior Customer Success Manager
description: About Zip Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before. The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA. Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups. Your Role We’re looking for a Senior Customer Success Manager (equivalent to a technical account manager) to manage our rapidly growing enterprise customer base across all industries. As a Sr. CSM, you’ll work closely with sales, implementation, engineering and product while also working with a variety of customer stakeholders. You will advise customers on how to transform the way they manage B2B purchasing across their business, creating immediate value and efficiency for employees through product adoption and enablement. This role is ideal for you if you enjoy being a product expert, creative problem solving, and want to work with a world-class team and customers such as Coinbase, Snowflake, Toast, Northwestern Mutual, Notion, Canva, Samsara, Databricks, Miro, and many more. You Will Help our largest customers drive procurement success on the Zip platform. Define customer business outcomes and partner with our customers to deliver those outcomes on a continuous basis. Act as a trusted procurement advisor and thought partner to continuously educate and enable our customers on Zip’s platform and procurement best practices. Identify champions and build relationships with key business stakeholders across Procurement, Finance, Legal, IT/Security, and Privacy/Compliance teams. Maintain high levels of customer engagement and satisfaction with a focus on customer adoption and loyalty. Manage customer health and hedge account risks based on data-driven adoption metrics. Partner closely with product and engineering to translate business needs and requirements into new solutions for customers, while skillfully managing customer expectations. Train and empower customers to be product specialists to become increasingly self-sufficient for their organization. Partner with the renewals team to achieve target GRR. Responsible for post implementation technical health of the client and perform hands on support in product adoption, and enablement. Continuously improve Customer Success assets and processes. We’re an early-stage company, we want people who are excited to build and motivated to up-level the status quo! Qualifications 8+ years of relevant work experience working in customer-facing customer success, technical account management or strategic consulting organization. B2B SaaS experience in a high-paced environment is a benefit. Prior SaaS implementation experience Procurement experience (procurement, sourcing, or vendor management background) and familiarity with procurement technologies such as ERP (Netsuite, Coupa, etc.), HRIS (Workday etc.), CLM, GRC, JIRA, ServiceNow workflow management tools. Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to establish quick rapport and trust with customers. Strong project management skills to manage a dynamic customer portfolio. Creative problem solver while being attentive to details. Business process-oriented and ability to think about workflow efficiency (e.g. diagrams, conditionally based logic, etc.). Proactive team player that is able to identify process gaps and willing to jump in and help wherever needed (company, team, self mentality). Nice to Haves Payments software experience (invoicing, PO creation) and background working with CFOs, Controller, Accounts Payable / Accounts Receivable roles. Experience with SaaS workflow management tools (low code / no code configuration). Experience working in a top tier consulting firm or have an MBA. Perks & Benefits At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work. 📈 Start-up equity 🦷 Health, vision & dental coverage 🚠 Team building events & happy hours 🌴 Flexible PTO 💻 Apple equipment plus home office budget 💸 401k plan We're looking to hire Zipsters and that means hiring people who take ownership, communicate openly, have an underdog mindset, and are excited to increase the pace of innovation for every business in the world. We encourage all candidates to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match up to our job description. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workspace where everyone (regardless of age, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, and more) feels like they belong. We look forward to hearing from you! Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.&nbsp;</span></p></div><h2><strong>Information about the position&nbsp;</strong></h2> <p>As Vinted Pay Partner Manager, you will be responsible for managing relationships across the entire Vinted Pay partner stack, optimizing our operating model for performance and cost efficiencies, payments business development and commercial negotiations.&nbsp;</p> <p>As Senior Manager Payments Partnerships, reporting to the Head of Vinted Pay Business and Commercial, you will have ownership of Vinted Pay’s external partner stack across the entire transaction lifecycle. You will move beyond traditional vendor management to build a dynamic, rigorous and competitive partner framework that continuously pressures pricing, improves performance, and expands our product capabilities. Additionally, you will act as an internal intrapreneur, working at the intersection of Business, Product, Engineering, Strategic Finance, and Legal, sourcing and building business cases for new fintech partnerships, that solve real user problems and deliver meaningful business impact.&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>In this position, you’ll&nbsp;</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Serve as one of the primary commercial and strategic owners for Vinted Pay’s and Marketplace partner ecosystem, covering Banks, Payment Processors, Payout providers, Identity Verification/KYC providers, and Risk &amp; Fraud prevention partners and the major and regional card networks.</li> <li>Architect a multi-provider operating model that fosters healthy tension among suppliers. We are looking for a high-judgment, high-ownership operator to join the CEO Office and turn the company's most important priorities into outcomes: someone driven, hungry and talented, comfortable balancing strategic thinking, research and decision-making with hands-on delivery and operational rigour. We collaborate with a wide range of teams across the organisation to drive maximum impact.

The CEO Office has a broad remit spanning strategic planning, cross-functional execution, leadership support, and special projects.

You will bring structure to ambiguous problems, drive complex work across teams, and combine analytical rigour with hands-on delivery. This is an opportunity to become a trusted partner to leadership and a force multiplier across Checkout.

  • You will support Checkout’s CEO and Head of CEOO to drive critical cross-functional initiatives by assuming day-to-day project leadership and enabling cross-departmental collaboration

  • You will help leadership navigate ambiguity, accelerate execution and drive cross-functional alignment across the company

  • You will operate across strategy and execution: taking ownership of ambiguous, high-priority problems, especially those spanning multiple teams or lacking a natural owner

  • You will navigate open-ended problems, including identifying and defining the problem before developing and implementing effective solutions

  • Projects may include: organisational model design, international expansion strategy, scaling new business lines globally, goal setting and strategic planning, go-to-market execution, regulatory, data and financial infrastructure initiatives, board & shareholder reporting

  • Builder mindset: You'd rather own the outcome than the recommendation, and you have evidence of building things that lasted beyond your involvement

  • A track record of impact: quantifiable business outcomes, rapid growth in responsibility, and competitive achievements inside or outside work

  • Experience in consulting, high-growth technology companies, investing, investment banking, strategic finance, or similarly high-performance environments

Bonus Points

  • Exposure to payments, fintech, or money movement

  • You have built low-code/no-code or AI automations that others still use

  • Advanced SQL or hands-on data analysis skills

  • International experience across multiple markets and cultures

  • Entrepreneurial experience: founded or helped build something from scratch

The CEO Office helps Checkout focus on what matters most and turn problem statements into business outcomes.

You’ll report to the Director of Enterprise Product Design and work from our London office three days a week.

The role

We’re looking for a Staff Product Designer to balance two connected responsibilities: lead design for Acquiring and evolve Checkout.com’s design system.

The design system accelerates and unifies product delivery, while Acquiring keeps its evolution grounded in practice. You’ll elevate the design system through code-first and AI-integrated workflows while taking full design ownership of Acquiring and bridging existing coverage gaps.

While you won’t manage direct reports, your impact will be significant: shaping how the system evolves and how the Acquiring team ships. You’ll lead through exceptional craft, technical fluency, and influence.

What you’ll own

  • Lead end-to-end design for Acquiring, mentoring designers and raising craft quality through critique and guidance.

  • Evolve Checkout.com’s cross-pillar design system across products and surfaces, including dashboard and mobile experiences

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to apply the system to real product needs and implementation constraints.

  • Improve how teams move from design intent to production.

What success looks like

  • Acquiring has consistent coverage and craft quality, with designers set up to execute independently.

  • The design system scales to help teams deliver consistent, high-quality experiences across products, surfaces, and new initiatives.
